parameters.content:
## SEO Agent — Publish Check (B3-7, v4.17)
`POST /webhook/seo-publish-check` (header auth: credential **SEO API Key**, header `X-API-Key`), synchronous (a second or two), **free** — no model, no fetch, no row written.

It runs the **deterministic half of the content gate** over the Markdown you send: *Content QA* and *Originality Check* are the content run's own node code, copied by the build and asserted identical, so a page that fails here is a page a content run would deliver as "not ready to publish". *Parse Brief* is named after the node of the content run whose part it plays (Content QA reads `$('Parse Brief')`).

Body: `{ markdown, keyword, domain?, page_type?, target_words?, terms?, competitors?: [{url, content, rank?, title?}], sources?: [{url, text}], internal_links?, business_facts?, currency?, country?, ai_question?, ai_fanout? }`.

**200** `{ ok, publishable, verdict: 'publishable' | 'not_publishable', exit_code: 0 | 1, label, summary, reasons, content_score, score_breakdown, warnings, advice, checks, fixed_markdown, auto_fixes, schema_types, not_checked: [{check, reason}], writes: 'none', cost_usd: 0 }` · **400** field errors (`exit_code: 2`).
CI in one line: `curl -s -H "X-API-Key: …" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d @page.json $URL/webhook/seo-publish-check | jq -e '.exit_code == 0'`.

What it cannot judge from what was sent (the editor's review — a model call —, figures without their source text, coverage without terms, originality without competitor pages, length without a target) is listed in `not_checked` **with the reason**, never as a pass.
